name: v0.3.9 return-cycle guard
cycle_rule: During an unresolved return phase, arriving at an exact destination signature already seen in that phase (parent not matched) is a return cycle. First exact repeat triggers escape. No N, no cluster-only trigger, no app hardcode.
escape_semantics: Abandon active branch: returning=false, active_branch empty, parent cleared, commitment_left=0. Do not _complete_branch. Do not increment return_success / completed_total. Do not add to returned/completed. Event return_cycle_escape; optional sequence_terminal outcome return_cycle_abandoned if instance still open.

contamination.buggy_shop: inspected mechanism-development case, not clean holdout
contamination.h1_h2: excluded; already inspected; not evaluation targets

B.label: Mechanism repaired, but regression/tradeoff
B.when: escape works but A shop novelty or DeepBench regression gates fail

C.label: Mechanism not repaired
C.when: no escape, lock persists, false return success, crash, or exact-repeat not implemented
